\par\smallskip\footnotesize
Deletion AUC: normalised system anomaly score as the top 0-10 indicators are reset to normal; lower = the explanation removes the anomaly faster. Random: 10 random orders. Beats random: share of cases below their random area.\par
The deletion test rewards removing the loudest columns. A method that ranks a quieter root-cause column above a louder inherited one is penalised by it by design, so read it alongside accuracy, not instead of it.\par
Compactness: median number of indicators holding 80\% of the positive score. Stability: alarm moved -10 s and +10 s; overlap with the unshifted answer.\par
